direction: The same northern English time-served engineer voice, now in an action platform game inside a hazardous rogue workshop. Alert, urgent, animated, projecting clearly over machinery. Brisk, punchy delivery with natural northern character; fully voiced, no whispering, no breathy ASMR, no slow narration. Say only the supplied words
design_prompt_reference_only: A time-served engineer from the north of England in his late fifties, a shop-floor voice: dry, plain, unhurried and quietly confident, with a clear northern English accent (short flat a in bath and grass, rounded u in bush and cut, dropped g on -ing), explaining machining to an apprentice. No brightness or salesmanship; matter-of-fact and warm underneath.
requirement: Reuse this saved voice ID. Never create a replacement voice from the description.
